## The Traveling Design: Mother of Pearl

The only design that has outsold this one is "Bangles del Aguila" and yet it's this one that has raised the most questions. There's no question as to the tall style of mug that you see here on the right ([Redbubble](https://www.redbubble.com/i/mug/Ocean-Treasure-Mother-of-Pearls-by-jayaprime/20967069/7yqg)). The Skybreak Tribe owns some of them, my friend Peter, and of course myself. They're perfect for tea time and the fade towards the handle works friggin' perfectly. She's a study in subtly and elegance at the same time.

However, what intrigues me is the _types_ of products that people have bought over the years. Were I psychic, I'd love to have seen these, to know where they appeared and how they've been used. This isn't the first time I've had these thoughts. Just a week ago, while I was working on this very site, Apple notified me that someone used Shazam to spot my song "Billy's Best Friend" on my album "[Into the Southwest](into-the-southwest)"... but in Ljubljana, the capital of Slovenia... and late on a Friday night. Like, I mean... _what bar in Slovenia is playing my music late on a Friday... and do they serve a dark beer that I'd like?_ Or whatever college radio stations in Argentina and Germany are playing my song "Kandela de Esperanza" ([SoundCloud](https://soundcloud.com/jaya-prime/kandela-de-esperanza)) for more than a decade now?

Every once in a while, I'll come across one of my designs on a phone case in the wild. I love to see how far the art has spread and indeed continues to spread. But more than 90% of these I never know about. In the case of "Mother of Pearl" the mystery goes even deeper. So while the tall mugs that remain her best seller are fairly well explained, that leaves plenty of other designs from that list that are a mystery.

\[[Prints + More on Redbubble](https://www.redbubble.com/shop/ap/20967069)\]

## Curio One: The Name tags _Who's buying the name tags?_ I wanna know! Zazzle's cool because buyers can add their own text to the design before finalizing the purchase. They have a lot of fonts, sizes, styles, and colors. Someone out there absolutely loves "Mother of Pearl" for their name tags, as every few months over the past decade another purchase comes in. My headcanon has it that there's a Mary K saleswoman out there, or a makeup artist throwing parties, and she picks these up for her VPs at events. Or maybe it's a guy? I really don't know and I want to know! If this is YOU, [contact me](contact). I'll not only re-post and share, but I could even promote your events. Is there a pearl-themed hotel, or restaurant, or something else that picks these up? Whatever it is, it slowed during the pandemic, then picked back up again in recent years. There's even someone out there who once bought a large collapsible screen with the design on it. I can still make those, but now that falls under custom designs, so again you'd need to [contact me](contact). I can even add this design to an Otterbox phone case, but I would need to know the make and model. For one of my top five best-selling designs of all time, I've never even once caught her in the wild. She's out there.. . I just don't know where. Most of the sells are in the United States. BTW, as my line-up on Zazzle is manufacturer-dependent, it's constantly shifting. So instead of linking to just one product, [this link to Zazzle](https://www.zazzle.com/store/fractalscapes/products?cg=196854947288822999) shows the currently available ones. Hardly representative, however, as I have a lot of other options available upon request.

## Curio Two: The House of Pearls

_Who's building their house made out of pearls?_

_I. Need. To. KNOW!!!_ Seriously, someone out there has been building a house made out of pearls and I'm dying to know! They've bought shower curtains, a duvet, and other accessories from [here on Redbubble](https://www.redbubble.com/shop/ap/20967069). But they didn't stop there. They've also bought the "Mother of Pearl" light switches and even wrapping paper from [here on Zazzle](https://www.zazzle.com/store/fractalscapes/products?cg=196854947288822999). Oh please I hope whoever's buying these reads these words one day and reaches out to me.

_The wrapping paper? Really?_ Half of me wonders if it could be used as wallpaper with a proper epoxy for shielding and longevity. At that point it wouldn't be all-too-different from the method we used for the "[Heart of the Rose](heart-of-the-rose)" fractal mural on 3M tiles. It'd also be a hellova lot cheaper!

My headcanon says someone loves the ocean itself and they've themed an entire bathroom and a guest bedroom using these. Every once in a while, I'll send Google the original design to see where it pops up. After sorting through the many thieves, usually I just find my own designs. So whoever's building "The House of Pearls" isn't sharing it online. . or, at least, it's not coming up in my searches.

Again, if this is you, please [contact me](contact). It would be incredible to see what you've built with her.

texts:
## The Mother of Pearl Design

On the design herself, it's no secret that I'm addicted to water. Once I'm in the waves, I can stay in for hours, losing myself floating atop them... . or diving into the depths. Over the years, I've become obsessed with the idea of the pearl, that a flaw and an irritant could become something so hypnotic and beautiful. Despite the subtly of the design, there are more than 30,000 colors used to create the opalescent iridescence within her spirals and golden crests. If you can't tell from my other works -- be they written, visual, or audio -- subtly is _not_ a hallmark of my style. The "Mother of Pearl" was a challenge to myself that I am grateful has been so wholeheartedly welcomed by others.

I do hope to one day find her in the wild and out in the world where she belongs.

Until that day, you can find some of her most popular products [here on Redbubble](https://www.redbubble.com/shop/ap/20967069).

### Extended Exploration

If you like this one, you really need to see my "[Heart of the Rose](heart-of-the-rose)" fractal mural or my now-legendary "[Great Blue Mandelbrot](great-blue-mandelbrot)" design. For those who like both fractals and astrology, my "[Nocturne of Scorpio](nocturne-of-scorpio)" fractal painting may draw you into her depths. Many of these, including "Mother of Pearl", appear in my book "[Spectral Iteration](spectral-iteration)" along with prose and poems with the geometry behind the art.
